event_name: Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 80 degrees, relative humidity 48 percent, barometer 30.07 inches,
adjusted altitude 2,764 feet, track temperature 129 degrees.

Langdon is 19 - 10 against Pruett in prior events. 

Shawn Langdon and Leah Pruett have raced 29 times.  Langdon has "left first" 19 times.
In those 29 races Langdon's average R/T is  .060
In those 29 races Pruett's average R/T is .073

Leah with the starting line advantage, but is up in smoke right at the hit and pedaled it.

Langdon with a good pass early, but started mixing up cylinders on the top end.  He gets the win.
Langdon is advancing to eighth final round this season and 29th of his career.

Kalitta is 5 - 1 against Stewart in prior events. 

Kalitta with a slight starting line advantage, but is up in smoke right at the hit and pedals it.
Kalitta will win the season championship and $150,000 and will go into the countdown as the number
one seed.

Stewart has a hole or two out on the top end, but gets the win.  He will give up lane choice to
Langdon in the final.  He is advancing to his second final this season and eighth of his career.
